Finding: In pre-release testing with OpenAI's system-level biological content filters disabled, SecureBio found GPT-5.6 Sol outperformed every model it had previously tested on three of its four knowledge benchmarks and scored higher than any human subject matter expert on all four; on World-Class Bio it scored 68%, about nine percentage points above GPT-5.5, and without the Codex harness it scored approximately 54% on the Virology Capabilities Test and 60% on the Molecular Biology Capabilities Test.
Finding Quote: GPT-5.6 Sol outperformed every model we have previously tested on three of our four knowledge benchmarks. It also scored higher than any human subject matter expert on each of our knowledge benchmarks, consistent with previous OpenAI models. The largest improvement from GPT-5.5 was achieved on World-Class Bio (WCB), an open-response test of niche biological knowledge held by only a handful of specialists in the world. GPT-5.6 Sol scored 68%, about nine percentage points above OpenAI's previous flagship model, GPT-5.5.
